description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_EntityLookup, which provides a lookup table for HTML entities, including setup and singleton access methods.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_EntityLookup
classes.description: Provides entity lookup table from entity name to character with singleton pattern and setup method.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the entity lookup table by reading and unserializing a serialized file.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the lookup class, creating and setting it up if it doesn't exist.
